story: Hopeville Pond State Park is located in Connecticut, USA, on Hopeville Pond in Griswold. A portion of the state park occupies the site of the lost village of Hopeville. The park features a forest and offers trails for hiking and biking, plus camping, fishing, swimming, and boating.
matters: The park includes Hopeville Pond, an impoundment of the Pachaug River. The Mohegan people historically constructed stone weirs to harvest fish from the river.
name: Hopeville Pond State Park
